ash: heads-up ") Quick run on compact dashboard charts: legend + Y-axis collisions on narrow tiles. kevin: saw it. when there are 5+ series the legend wraps and card heights differ -> rows misalign. rita: option: compact chips (swatch + short name) that collapse into a single pill `Series (N)`. expand in-place, no layout shift. omar: love pill idea. when collapsed it should show count and a tiny chevron. expand opens overlay anchored to card (not pushing layout). ash: (typo) ash: also units: large numbers cause tick crowding. propose condensed units (K/M) at <=160px width, with full value revealed on hover/focus. kevin: for hover reveal make sure keyboard users can access it (enter opens popover). aria: include full value in a hidden describe element. rita: smoothing is ambiguous. suggest labels: "Visual smoothing" (keeps markers for spikes) and "Resample (performance)". small help text under each. omar: outliers: don't clip axis. instead dim outlier points and show an off-scale caret at axis edge with tooltip: "Off-scale value: 12,345,678 (99.99th pct). Click to include in scale." a11y-bot: checklist: "legend pill has aria-expanded; collapsed name includes count; expand moves focus to first item; tick labels have aria-describedby with full numeric string; off-scale marker keyboard focusable and announces value and percentile". ash: (ash) microcopy idea for pill: visible label "Series (4)"; sr-only: "Expand series list, 4 items". kevin: dev constraint: renderer is canvas; avoid per-point DOM changes. Use one-pass draw for dimming and a mask texture for selective alpha. I'll file an infra note. rita: UI tweak: when dimming active show badge "Outlier dimming" next to pill; clicking it opens policy modal (slider + histogram preview + sparkline preview). omar: histogram preview is great for non-technical folks. slider should show live update on a tiny sparkline thumbnail. kevin: implementation note: histogram can be precomputed on server for the selected range to avoid heavy client compute. a11y-bot: aria wording suggestion for band explanation: "typical range (10th0th percentile) for " keep <=120 chars. Also: "off-scale marker announcement: data point dimmed by auto-scale, value , percentile

". ash: (ash) smoothing hint copy: "Visual smoothing clarifies trends but can hide brief spikes; disable to inspect raw points." short and to the point. rita: legend expand keyboard behavior: Tab to pill, Enter -> expand, focus lands on first legend row; Esc closes and returns focus to pill. Also ensure focus ring contrast >=4.5:1. kevin: will enforce focus color in CSS variables. note: avoid pale thin outline. omar: small-multiples alignment: set collapsed-legend fixed height (e.g., 32px) to keep rows aligned; expanded overlay floats above so no layout changes. a11y-bot: add checklist item: "collapsed legend fixed height for layout parity; expand overlay role=dialog aria-modal=false; return focus on close". ash: (ash) tooltip copy for outlier: use "dimmed by auto-scale" instead of "clipped". more accurate. kevin: perf: alpha for band fills should be a uniform shader uniform; per-series dropout via mask texture. avoids CPU per-point. I'll add example shader snippet to infra ticket. rita: action items: 1) I'll draft pill and popover microcopy + SR labels. 2) Kevin to open infra ticket with shader mask sketch. 3) Omar to mock pill overlay + histogram slider in Figma. 4) A11y-bot to add checklist and example aria strings. a11y-bot: I'll publish checklist and sample announcements in #accessibility and add a short QA script for keyboard + screen reader checks. kevin: I'll also prototype a small staging build for the pill interaction next week. ash: (ash) thanks all 3 aiming to ship legend/unit/outlier changes next sprint. :thumbsup:
